summary: Frontend-only re-test on Expo web preview (390x844). Regressions: PASS — all 3 tabs render (tab-today, tab-upcoming, tab-jobs), visible and tappable, navigation works. Bug2: PASS — 'Deadline' label is visible above the quick-add date control. Note: the 'No deadline' empty text is only rendered on native; on web the DateTimeField renders <input type=datetime-local> and shows the browser placeholder (mm/dd/yyyy). Feature1 web-testable parts: PASS for toggle-done → global undo bar (testID undo-bar + undo-btn) appears on both Today and Upcoming, Undo restores task. FAIL for delete-undo: tapping detail-delete does NOT show any undo bar (bug — see rca_of_issue). Swipe gestures are native-only and were not exercised. Demo mode: PASS — Settings > demo-mode-toggle ON shows 'SAMPLE DATA — Demo Mode' badge (demo-mode-indicator) on Today and Job board renders exactly 8 application cards; toggling OFF hides badge and restores real data. Task detail: PASS — detail-title present, switching list to 'job' via detail-list-job reveals detail-company, detail-role, detail-link, detail-stage-{to_apply|applied|interviewing|offer|rejected}, detail-next-action. Job board add-application: PASS — add-application-btn opens /application/new; new-app-company/new-app-role/new-app-stage-applied/new-app-save flow creates a card visible on the board. Settings test-notification-btn: PASS — shows web-only feedback (permission status 'Web (no notifications)'). Native-only items (snooze notification actions, actual swipe-right/left, exact Android edge-to-edge inset) confirmed not-verifiable-on-web; no import/runtime crash observed for these code paths.

ui_bugs.issue: Detail-delete does not surface an undo bar labelled 'Task deleted'. Spec requires deleting a task to always show the global undo affordance. On web, detail-delete is the ONLY way to delete a task (swipe is native), so the undo bar never appears for deletions from the web preview. Add: useUndo().showUndo('Task deleted', () => restoreTask(snapshot)) after capturing the task snapshot and before router.back(). Reference: /app/frontend/app/task/[id].tsx:118-121

issues: On web the 'emptyText' prop ('No deadline') is intentionally never rendered because <input type=datetime-local> shows the browser's own mm/dd/yyyy placeholder. This matches code and is acceptable, but if 'No deadline' should be user-visible on web too, consider rendering a small Text next to/under the input when value is null.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated JSX prop pointerEvents="box-none" on View. Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/UndoBar.tsx:42

action_items: HIGH: Add showUndo('Task deleted', () => restoreTask(snapshot)) inside doDelete in /app/frontend/app/task/[id].tsx (capture task snapshot before deleteTask). This is the primary delete path on web and currently silently deletes with no undo — violates Feature1 spec.
LOW: Move pointerEvents="box-none" from JSX prop to style in UndoBar.tsx to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Only Today screen (index.tsx handleDelete) wires showUndo for deletes; upcoming.tsx and task/[id].tsx do not — the global UndoProvider is in place, so simply calling useUndo().showUndo(...) from those screens would give consistent UX everywhere.

SwipeableTaskRow uses react-native-gesture-handler/ReanimatedSwipeable — gestures cannot be driven by Playwright drag on web reliably (the row still tap-navigates correctly). Snooze notification handling (expo-notifications categories + response listener) is guarded by Platform.OS check and correctly no-ops on web.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage each run; created two real tasks ('DetailJob check', 'Detail job task') and one real application (TestCo / SDE / Applied). Demo mode used for the 8-app-card verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The delete-undo regression is a single-line fix in app/task/[id].tsx doDelete — main agent can self-verify. To reproduce: on web preview, add a task, open it via task-row, tap detail-delete (accept confirm dialog); observe no [data-testid=undo-bar] appears. All other flows in the review request verified. Storage keys unchanged: tp.tasks.v1 / tp.demoTasks.v1 / tp.demoMode.v1. Correct application testIDs: application-card-{id}, new-app-{company|role|link|stage-<name>|next-action|save}. Detail stage testIDs are detail-stage-{to_apply|applied|interviewing|offer|rejected}.
rca_of_issue: Feature1 spec states 'Deleting a task should also surface an undo bar labelled Task deleted.' The handler was added to index.tsx (Today screen) handleDelete, but the shared detail delete handler at /app/frontend/app/task/[id].tsx:118-121 (function doDelete) was not updated. It calls await deleteTask(task.id) then router.back() — no showUndo. On web this is the only reachable delete path (swipe-left is native-only), so the delete-undo capability is effectively inaccessible on the web preview. Fix: import useUndo, capture task snapshot before deleteTask, call showUndo('Task deleted', () => restoreTask(snapshot)) after deletion. Same treatment should be applied to any other delete call site (upcoming.tsx if it exposes a delete path).
